decisions: All 22 current p.146 pending_promotion candidates receive guide/form triage from recovered ALC1737 OCR plus explicit BUE1890 secondary control.
No candidate is promoted in this pass because direct ALC1737 facsimile recollation is unavailable through the current retrieval path.
Candidates with near OCR/control convergence are prioritized for a future direct same-witness facsimile pass because they are the most likely high-yield promotions.
BUE1890 is used only to corroborate guide identity, sequence, or the location of likely OCR damage; its readings are not copied into ALC1737.
Historical spelling/normalization differences are preserved as evidence rather than silently regularized.

provenance.method: Conservative Phase II triage from the public ALC1737 Internet Archive full-text OCR, compared against explicit BUE1890 secondary-control OCR. No facsimile-level promotion and no human verification.

epistemicGuards: The public Internet Archive OCR is evidence from the ALC1737 witness but is not equivalent to direct visual facsimile collation.
BUE1890 is a later edited reprint and may normalize orthography, spacing, punctuation, or lexical organization.
No reading in this file should be cited as human_verified.
No precision/recall/F1 metric is inferred from this triage because the visible-start census remains non-exhaustive.
